abstract: Forty-one patients with advanced non-seminoma germ cell testicular tumours were treated by chemotherapy, with or without radiotherapy, followed by excision of residual para-aortic lymph node masses. All para-aortic metastases were initially greater than 2 cm, 35 were larger than 5 cm, and 9 were over 10 cm in diameter. Seven patients also had nodal deposits above the diaphragm and 18 had distant metastases. The residual masses were excised completely in all except 3 cases. Residual malignancy was found in 7 (18%) of 38 operable cases; of these 7, only 2 remain alive and disease-free. In contrast, 28 (90%) of 31 operable cases with necrosis and fibrosis, or with fully differentiated teratoma, are alive and disease-free. Elevated serum markers were found in 6 of 9 cases with resectable or unresectable residual malignancy, but in only 1 of 32 who were tumour-free. Residual malignancy was found in 3 (9%) of 34 cases with normal marker levels. Malignancy was not found in any residual mass less than 4 cm diameter. We conclude that excision of para-aortic lymph node masses should be electively delayed until serum markers become normal and until shrinkage of the mass has ceased. The presence of residual malignancy in the excised tissue then provides a clear indication for further chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 進行性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者41例を化学療法（放射線療法の併用の有無を含む）で治療し、その後、残存する傍大動脈リンパ節腫瘤を切除した。すべての傍大動脈転移は初診時に2cmを超えており、35例は5cm超、9例は10cm超であった。7例は横隔膜より上の結節転移を、18例は遠隔転移を有していた。3例を除き全例で残存腫瘤を完全切除した。切除可能であった38例中7例（18%）に残存悪性腫瘍を認め、このうち生存して無病であるのは2例のみであった。一方、壊死と線維化、または完全に分化した奇形腫を示した31例中28例（90%）は生存して無病である。残存悪性腫瘍を有する切除不能または切除可能な9例中6例では血清腫瘍マーカーが上昇していたが、悪性腫瘍が認められなかった32例では1例のみであった。マーカーが正常であった34例中3例（9%）に残存悪性腫瘍を認めた。直径4cm未満の残存腫瘤には悪性腫瘍は認められなかった。結論として、傍大動脈リンパ節腫瘤の切除は、血清マーカーが正常化し腫瘤の縮小が止まるまで待機的に延期すべきである。切除組織に残存悪性腫瘍が認められれば、さらなる化学療法の明確な適応となる。
